Formula Labels start at the vertex id. Each synchronous round, every vertex counts votes(c) for each candidate label c: one self vote plus one vote per weak neighbor (self-loops skipped; duplicate edges vote separately). It takes the label with most votes, the lowest label on ties, written to a scratch column and published after the round. Directed graphs also vote through reverse CSR. Overflow publishes 0xffffffff.
